acceptance_criteria.criterion: Neither `pollingManager.test.ts` nor `pollingManager.errorLog.test.ts` contains a local `BASE_CONFIG` definition.

summary: Migrated both polling manager test files to use the shared makeTestConfig factory. Removed local BASE_CONFIG literal objects from pollingManager.test.ts and pollingManager.errorLog.test.ts, replaced each with `const BASE_CONFIG = makeTestConfig('/fake')` which yields identical field values (projectsFolder: '/fake/projects', storageFolder: '/fake/storage', plus all other defaults). Added import of makeTestConfig from '../../tests/test-helpers.js' to both files. Also removed the now-unused `import type { AppConfig }` from pollingManager.test.ts (it was only needed for the BASE_CONFIG type annotation). All 834 tests pass with zero failures and tsc --noEmit exits cleanly.

comments.note: pollingManager.errorLog.test.ts still retains `import type { AppConfig }` (used in the AC5 local config overrides like `const config: AppConfig = { ...BASE_CONFIG, projectsFolder: '/fake/projects' }`). These spread overrides are now redundant since makeTestConfig('/fake') already produces projectsFolder '/fake/projects' — they could be simplified to just `BASE_CONFIG` directly, eliminating the need for the AppConfig import. Out of scope for this WP but a clean-up opportunity.

pollingManager.test.ts had its `import type { AppConfig }` removed as part of this migration (it was only needed for the BASE_CONFIG type annotation). The errorLog test file keeps it for the AC5 spread patterns; those spreads are effectively no-ops and could be removed in a follow-up.
